<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def barpos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            b=n['boundary']; return (min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b))
def timer(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N': return max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
tops=[12,16,20,24,28,32,36,40,44]; lefts=list(range(0,45,4))
order=[(t,l) for ri,t in enumerate(tops) for l in (lefts if ri%2==0 else lefts[::-1])]
cur=barpos(current_frame)
idx=order.index(cur) if cur in order else 0
print("start",cur,"timer",timer(current_frame))
steps=0
for pos in order[idx+1:]:
    dt=pos[0]-cur[0]; dl=pos[1]-cur[1]
    act={4:'DOWN',-4:'UP'}.get(dt) or {4:'RIGHT',-4:'LEFT'}.get(dl)
    if act is None: break
    action([act]); steps+=1
    won=bool(last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('run_complete'))
    go=last_action_result.get('game_over')
    cur=barpos(current_frame)
    if won or go: print("STOP",act,cur,"won",won,"go",go); break
    if timer(current_frame)<6: print("timer low stop",cur); break
print("steps",steps,"final",barpos(current_frame),"timer",timer(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
